claims.sentence: On 25 September 2026 the WHO announced which virus strains influenza vaccines should contain for the 2027 southern hemisphere season.
claims.evidence: WHO news item dated 25-09-2026 (URL) and search text: 'WHO published the recommendation on 25 September 2026'; strain-meeting framing matches.

claims.sentence: The WHO announced its recommendation for the 2027 southern hemisphere flu season on 25 September 2026, after a consultation held from 21 to 24 September.
claims.evidence: Event page URL dated 21 Sept 2026 and search text: 'consultation ran 21-24 September 2026 at the WHO Academy in Lyon, recommendation announced 25 September 2026'. Search summary blends pages; dates come from WHO event/news pages.

claims.sentence: This recommendation is for the southern hemisphere; the next one, for the 2027-28 northern hemisphere season, is due in February 2027.
claims.evidence: WHO FAQ: 'WHO plans to make a recommendation in February 2027 relating to vaccines that will be used for the NH 2027-28 influenza season.'

claims.sentence: The 2027 southern hemisphere viruses differ from those recommended for the 2026 southern hemisphere vaccine.
claims.evidence: WHO FAQ: composition for 2027 SH 'is different from those viruses recommended for the 2026 southern hemisphere vaccine'.

claims.sentence: On 25 September 2026 the World Health Organization (WHO) announced its recommendations for the virus strains in influenza vaccines for the 2027 southern hemisphere season.
claims.evidence: News item on who.int dated 25-09-2026 with title announcing recommendations for the 2027 southern hemisphere season.

claims.sentence: The recommendation followed a consultation held from 21 to 24 September 2026.
claims.evidence: Event page 21 Sept 2026 and search text 'consultation ran 21-24 September 2026'. Search summary; confirms dates.

claims.sentence: National regulators and manufacturers use the recommendations in vaccine development and licensing.
claims.evidence: WHO recommendations page: 'used by national vaccine regulatory agencies and pharmaceutical companies ... to develop, produce, and license influenza vaccines'.

claims.sentence: For egg-based vaccines the WHO recommends an A/Missouri/11/2025 (H1N1)pdm09-like virus, an A/Darwin/1454/2025 (H3N2)-like virus and a B/Tokyo/EIS13-175/2025 (B/Victoria lineage)-like virus.
claims.evidence: WHO technical document: egg-based = A/Missouri/11/2025 (H1N1)pdm09-like; A/Darwin/1454/2025 (H3N2)-like; B/Tokyo/EIS13-175/2025 (B/Victoria lineage)-like. All three names match character by character. Cell/recombinant/nucleic-acid vaccines use A/Darwin/1415/2025 and B/Pennsylvania/14/2025; the sentence correctly limits itself to egg-based, but the site might add that other platforms differ.

claims.sentence: The WHO says the 2027 southern hemisphere viruses differ from those recommended for the 2026 southern hemisphere vaccine, and that they match the components recommended for the 2026-27 northern hemisphere vaccine.
claims.evidence: WHO FAQ: different from 2026 SH; 'align with the components recommended in the northern hemisphere 2026-27 vaccine composition'. Came from FAQ pdf text in search; not re-read on the news page itself.

claims.sentence: A separate recommendation for the 2027-28 northern hemisphere season is planned for February 2027.
claims.evidence: WHO FAQ: recommendation planned February 2027 for NH 2027-28 season.

notes: Search summaries blend pages; strain names confirmed in the WHO technical document text returned by two separate searches, with H3N2/B names for non-egg vaccines differing (A/Darwin/1415/2025, B/Pennsylvania/14/2025). Egg-based names in the brief match exactly. Consider noting that non-egg vaccines use different H3N2 and B viruses.
